The realignment is notable as many of the leaders celebrated their ideological ties with Trump following his victory in 2024, with some of them visiting Washington DC since…

ai.sum: European far-right politicians began distancing themselves from Trump after Democrats won the US midterms, blaming the Iran war, while avoiding direct criticism of him.

europe.title: Afghan pushback survivor fights ‘impossible’ evidence rules in European courts with new UN case against Greece
europe.summary: The EU's human rights court rejected a case from an Afghan pushback survivor who was just 15 years old when he was turned back to Turkey by the Hellenic coast guard. The impossibility of achieving justice on the systematic practice against migrants of all ages was highlighted by the European court's inadmission, as the young survivor was forced to appeal to the UN's human rights courts instead.

ai.sum: The EU human rights court rejected a case from a 15-year-old Afghan pushback survivor turned back to Türkiye by Greek coast guard, who now turns to UN bodies.

europe.title: Pezeshkian receives credentials of five new ambassadors, calls for stronger ties and regional peace
europe.summary: TEHRAN – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on Tuesday, November 3, received the credentials of the newly appointed ambassadors of Cyprus, Switzerland, Turkey, Nigeria and Portugal in separate ceremonies at the presidential office, calling for stronger bilateral relations and greater diplomatic efforts to promote peace and stability.

ai.sum: Iranian President Pezeshkian received credentials of new ambassadors, including Turkey's, and called for stronger ties.

europe.title: Russia fails in bid to reverse ban on its ships using Europe’s docks and locks
europe.summary: Russian authorities challenged restrictive measures imposed by EU ministers against ships approved by the St Petersburg ship-certifying body. The EU's General Court rejected a bid to overturn the ban, but left the door open for future recognition of the authority.

ai.sum: The EU General Court rejected Russia's challenge to the EU ban on ships certified by St Petersburg bodies using European docks and locks.

europe.title: Turkey says EU comments on its rights record, judiciary are 'prejudiced, unfair'
europe.summary: ANKARA, Nov 4 (Reuters) - Ankara rejected on Wednesday what it called the "prejudiced and unfair" stance of the European Union towards fundamental rights and the judiciary in Turkey, and regarding Cyprus, contained in the bloc's report on EU membership candidates. In its annualenlargement policy report, the European Commission said that while the EU had advanced ties with Turkey in areas of mutual interest, legal action by Turkish authorities against elected officials,…

ai.sum: Ankara rejected the EU Commission's annual enlargement report criticism of Türkiye's rights record, judiciary and Cyprus stance as prejudiced and unfair.
